mufasa.name: Mufasa
mufasa.oneLiner: AI fitness coach built for Indian diets and budgets.
mufasa.text: Generates personalised workout and meal plans based on body type, dietary preference (vegetarian, eggetarian, non-vegetarian or vegan), budget and activity level. Macronutrient targets are calculated deterministically (Mifflin-St Jeor → TDEE), and Gemini output is validated against them before it is saved. Plans are regenerated only when the profile changes, which keeps API costs low.

NotchIsland.oneLiner: A free, open-source Dynamic Island for the MacBook notch.
NotchIsland.text: Hovering over the notch reveals system-wide now-playing controls, picture-in-picture for calls and browser video that persists across Spaces, drag-and-drop AirDrop, clipboard history, audio device switching, and call detection that requires no permissions. Each permission is requested only when the relevant feature is first used.
